Map organisation codes to ODS codes and fetch ODS organisation data

map_to_ods_codes.Rd

Each row is matched to an ODS code using the mapping table, in this order:

  1. the full key in by (e.g. code and name together)

  2. the source code alone, if the table gives only one ODS code

Usage

map_to_ods_codes(
  data,
  mapping,
  by,
  to = setdiff(names(mapping), by)[1],
  ods_col = "ods_org_code",
  english_only = TRUE,
  include_cols = c("org_name", "org_type", "org_country", "org_region_code",
    "org_region", "org_legal_start", "org_legal_end", "org_operational_start",
    "org_operational_end", "org_successors"),
  on_missing = c("warn", "error", "silent")
)

Arguments

data

A dataframe containing the codes to map

mapping

A dataframe linking source codes to ODS codes

by

Character. Links columns in data to columns in mapping: names are columns in data, values are columns in mapping, and an unnamed value means the column has the same name in both. The first entry is the source code. Extra entries (e.g. an organisation name) separate codes that cover more than one organisation. Codes and names are compared ignoring case and surrounding spaces.

to

Character. Column in mapping holding the ODS codes (default: the first column of mapping not used in by)

ods_col

Character. Name of the column added to data to hold the resulting ODS codes

english_only

Logical. Filter to include English (and N/A) organisations

include_cols

Character. ODS columns to add. Default adds all. Choose from: org_name, org_type, org_country, org_region_code, org_region; the dates org_legal_start, org_legal_end, org_operational_start and org_operational_end; and org_successors, a list column holding the codes of the organisation's immediate successors (empty if none). A legal end date shows that an organisation has closed. ODS often gives start dates a default of 1 April or 1 October.

on_missing

Character. What to do when codes are ambiguous, not found in ODS, or the request fails: "warn" (default) warns and carries on, "error" stops, "silent" does nothing.

Value

Original dataframe with an ODS code column (ods_col) and organisation data joined on

Details

A code that is in the table but still has more than one possible ODS code is given NA (and reported according to on_missing). Codes not in the table are assumed to be ODS codes already.
